scope: Exact six-race prospective cohort frozen in KEIRIN_PROSPECTIVE_COHORT_LOCK_20260911_v1.json only.

primary_endpoint.name: candidate_top1_hit_rate
primary_endpoint.per_race_definition: 1 iff frozen B1a top1 car_no equals official actual winner car_no; else 0
primary_endpoint.aggregation: arithmetic mean of the three binary hits

multiclass_brier.per_race_definition: sum_i((p_i-y_i)^2) across all starters, where p_i is frozen B1a win probability and y_i is 1 only for the official winner
multiclass_brier.normalization: no division by number of starters
multiclass_brier.aggregation: arithmetic mean across the three candidates

two_shatan_exact_hit_count.definition: count candidate races where frozen ordered 2車単 ticket exactly matches official first-second order

san_rentan_exact_hit_count.definition: count candidate races where frozen ordered 3連単 ticket exactly matches official first-second-third order

selection_integrity.definition: report all 6 frozen members with original PASS/REJECT state; no member may disappear after outcomes

economic_claim_boundary.without_payout_or_actual_odds: report only predictive hit/probability metrics and frozen break-even thresholds; do not claim realized ROI or profit

science.interpretation: pilot prospective evidence; insufficient by itself for robust statistical proof or automatic 100% promotion
science.next_gate: After explicit RESULT authorization and race completion, evaluate all six locked members under this exact protocol. PAYOUT remains separately gated.
